relationship: Changing incidence angle and the refractive-index boundary connects refraction to the critical threshold and total internal reflection, with calculation checked against the visible ray behaviour.

learnerLoop.action: Rotate a source, observe and mark the limiting ray, calculate diamond, independently predict water to air, then reverse that same boundary.
learnerLoop.modelChange: Snell’s law and unpolarised Fresnel reflectance derive from the same two refractive indices and incidence angle.
learnerLoop.evidence: An escaping ray becomes a grazing ray and then disappears; normal-referenced angles and calculation agree.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Calculate another threshold or test whether any threshold exists for a reversed pair.

invariants: Angles are measured from the normal and refraction follows the same index ratio used in the calculation.
A critical angle exists only from higher to lower refractive index; total internal reflection requires exceeding it.
Guidance levels change calculation support without removing the physical threshold investigation.
safeAdaptations: Change index examples and prediction wording within the existing optical model.
Adjust working support while preserving the observe, mark and calculate sequence.
nonGoals: Do not present total internal reflection as occurring at every boundary or every angle.
Do not expand into wave interference or a full optical-instrument simulator.

actions.description: One persistent primary action; Back and optional previously-visited Forward are secondary. Model-specific callbacks and gates are unchanged.
actions.visibility: Same relative position below the apparatus and working; before saved readings.

help.description: Learner-requested evidence cue, relationship hint and contrasting worked example; no automatic answer-directed pulse.
help.visibility: Only when requested in the relevant experience.

reset.description: Native disclosure with ordered actions and scope descriptions; full restart uses an inline confirmation. Cancel, Escape, outside click and tab-away preserve the current model.
reset.visibility: Disclosure always available; reset actions disabled during model transitions. Confirmation is never opened automatically.

prompt.description: A short goal and action sentence above the apparatus, with a guided-step label and quiet restart disclosure.

model.description: Snell’s law and unpolarised Fresnel reflectance derive from the same two refractive indices and incidence angle.
model.visibility: Always visible; later controls are progressively disclosed.

comparison.description: Frozen readings and explicitly labelled comparison conditions; graphical overlays use the selected saved reading.

navigation.description: Back and Forward restore snapshots; Repeat resets the current experience; Confirmed restart clears the session.
navigation.visibility: Back and Forward depend on visited progress.

working.description: Worked examples precede learner calculations. Explicit quantity keys connect source labels to formula operands, with matching highlights and a button-triggered trace. Hover, focus and tap explain each source and calculation.

evidence.description: An escaping ray becomes a grazing ray and then disappears; normal-referenced angles and calculation agree.
evidence.visibility: In-place feedback; readings only in relevant steps.

completion.description: The persistent dock button runs the current test/check and changes to Continue only after the original model-derived criterion. Feedback and help share this dock; presentation does not set completion.
completion.visibility: Guided steps; absent in the open experiment.

angle.description: Measured incidence or an untested predicted critical angle; the latter withholds outgoing rays until testing.
angle.domain: 5 to 80 degrees guided; first step limited to 35 degrees. Experiment: 0 to 89.9 degrees.
angle.output: Rays, reflected/transmitted power, angular marks and regime.

critical.description: c = asin(n outside / n inside), only if n inside > n outside.
critical.domain: Degrees; no critical angle when the index condition fails.

modes.guided: Small ordered visual investigations, with model actions and in-place revision.
modes.experiment: Ungated experiment with either medium and hypothetical indices; select frozen readings to compare a saved threshold and retain original numerical indices.

dependencies: Rotate beyond 29 degrees, while limited below the first critical angle.
Observe angles on both sides of c and mark within 0.55 degrees; the accepted marker snaps to c.
Replace glass with diamond, then supply the index ratio and inverse-sine result and test the beam. Earlier working shows the same calculation for glass. Edits immediately clear success.

Predict water to air without a supplied substitution. Explicit testing accepts an angle within 0.3 degrees and aligns the measured limiting ray, then reversing the same boundary demonstrates no critical angle. No compulsory endpoint sweep.
Ungated experiment with either medium and hypothetical indices; select frozen readings to compare a saved threshold and retain original numerical indices.
implementation.completion: New experiences require their model-derived criterion. Back and Forward revisit saved state without forcing a rerun; Repeat experience resets only that experience. Confirmed restart clears all session snapshots. Worked observations are not mastery claims.
limitations: Ideal lossless flat boundary; radial entry through the semicircular face is normal to that face. Unpolarised Fresnel power. The grazing ray at c indicates a limiting direction.
Custom media accept hypothetical indices from 1 to 3.5; they do not represent measured real materials. Saved readings retain both indices.
Ray lengths are illustrative. A minimum ray opacity preserves visibility; the saved power values are physical model values.
